description:
MD simulation of Tyrosine-protein kinase JAK3 (Uniprot: P52333), in complex with a ligand. The simulation is based on the structure from PDB entry 3zc6.
This is part of a collection containing molecular dynamics simulations of 59 kinases both in their apo form and in complex with a total 220 ligands  (average of ~4 ligands per kinase). All-atom simulations were performed using GROMACS v2024 with the CHARMM36 force field (July 2020 version), and ligand parameters were generated with SwissParam. The protein was solvated in a periodic dodecahedron box with TIP3P water and neutralized with Na+/Cl− ions at 150 mM. Protonation states were assigned at pH 7 based on pKa values from propKa. Systems were energy minimized using the steepest descent algorithm for 5000 steps, followed by equilibration consisting of 1 ns with heavy-atom restraints (1000 kJ/mol/nm2) and 10 ns without restraints. Production simulations were carried out in the NPT ensemble for 500 ns in four replicates with different velocity seeds. A timestep of 2 fs was used, and coordinates were saved every 10 ps. Bonds involving hydrogens were constrained using LINCS. Electrostatics were treated with the Particle-Mesh Ewald method (grid spacing 0.12 nm, cubic interpolation), and van der Waals and electrostatic cutoffs were set to 1.0 nm. A long-range dispersion correction for energy and pressure was applied. Periodic boundary conditions were applied in all directions. The dataset also includes RMSD, RMSF, binding pocket analysis, kinase conformational states, residue-residue correlations, and distance measurements as detailed in the accompanying README_analysis.txt.
